settings.entropy_schedule: linear across scheduled optimizer batches; initial at first, final at last
settings.recurrent_training: full own-decision sequence BPTT from zero each epoch
settings.advantage_normalization: all decisions in the on-policy world batch

protocol.primary_evaluation: stochastic; common uniforms indexed by seed/world/tick/citizen across conditions
protocol.recipient_intervention: Pre-first-delivery clone; same index actions/cost/physics; one recipient's future report stream sealed
protocol.recipient_selection: earliest tick with any admitted report; lowest recipient, then sender, then source node
recipient_outcomes: recipient completed production and physical contributions
protocol.no_opportunity_worlds: retained with unknown effect, not imputed zero
protocol.neural_reset: only recurrent hidden state; explicit belief memory and previous commands remain
protocol.fixed_dispatch: frozen-policy protocol intervention; not a separately trained scheduler comparison
protocol.checkpoint_selection: final declared update only; no held-out selection or stopping
protocol.independent_units: crossed training and world seeds; citizens/ticks/messages are not replicates
protocol.uncertainty: exploratory crossed bootstrap; only three training seeds; one common action stream per paired world

limits: Only three training seeds, twelve held-out physical world seeds, and one common action stream per paired seed/world
Recurrent actor has 1024 more parameters than same-width feedforward actor; this is not a capacity-matched comparison
Neural reset, unread-at-test, and fixed dispatch are frozen-policy interventions with distribution-shift caveats
Recipient effects concern one deterministically selected recipient report stream, not every message or every possible recipient
All72 recurrent forks have zero observed production difference under their sampled action streams; this is not proof of universal zero effect
Quiet shutdown travel increases rather than reliably withdrawing; production reaching zero is imposed by absent orders
Greedy execution collapses output for both learned architectures and must not replace the declared stochastic policy
Old v0.2 and new v0.3 scores differ in seeds, actions, history inputs, algorithm, budgets, and sampling
No live Forge policy adapter, invented occupations, contracts, wages, replacement tests, or large-population acceptance
